name: ELEVATED CONTROL PLATFORM
text: Metal stairs lead up to a raised gangway
overlooking the main reactor. A complex
console bristles with archaic switches and
glowing monitors.

name: LOWER MAINTENANCE CORRIDOR
text: A recessed corridor branches off, the floor
plating reflecting a warm, ambient light from
an unseen source. Thick pipes run along the
lower wall.

name: CORE CONTAINMENT RING
text: A heavy metal collar encircles the glowing
energy pillar. Thick, insulated cables snake
outward from its base, routing power to the
surrounding facility.

name: COOLANT TANK ALCOVE
text: A row of glass cylinders glows with a sickly
green luminescence. Dials monitor the pressure
of the fluid bubbling within.

name: FLOOR GRATING TRENCH
text: A wide, grated vent covers a recessed trough
in the floor. It offers drainage or perhaps
cooling for the heavy cables snaking past it.

name: POWER CABLE BUNDLE
text: Heavy, braided cables unspool from the central
ring, trailing across the warning stripes
painted on the floor. They look old but still
hum with current.

name: OBSERVATION GANTRY OVERHANG
text: A sturdy metal gantry provides access to the
main control terminal. Its shadow falls over
the cables snaking towards the reactor below.

name: OPEN FLOOR VENT
text: A dark, rectangular vent is set into the floor
tiles near the wall. A loose piece of grating
has been shoved aside.

name: WALL JUNCTION CABLES
text: Thick power lines route from a wall-mounted
junction box down to the main reactor base.
The insulation looks brittle with age.

name: FLOOR ROUTED CABLES
text: A tangle of heavy wires snakes across the
hazard striping, connecting the central ring
to a floor-mounted socket.

name: LOWER VENTILATION GRATE
text: A wide ventilation grate is set flush into the
floor plating. Faint mechanical thrums vibrate
through the metal.

name: UPPER REACTOR HOUSING
text: The top cap of the energy pillar is secured
with heavy bolts. Thick cables feed directly
into its central node.

name: FLOOR DRAINAGE GRATE
text: A dark, slotted grating is built into the
floor near the right wall. It looks like it
handles heavy drainage for the nearby tanks.

name: CORE SUPPORT BUTTRESS
text: A solid, angled support buttress reinforces
the base of the reactor ring. It's built to
withstand immense pressure from within.
